title: Port O Call Marina

services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing cruise through Naples Bay viewing multi-million dollar mansions and the surrounding areas of Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands in luxury and comfort. We tell you the best places to see dolphins, herons, egrets, osprey, turtles, bald eagles and an abundance of other wildlife in their natural habitat. Need a fabulous destination? We suggest cruising to Keewaydin Island. This hot spot is known for its white sand, clear water and some of the best shelling in southwest Florida. Looking for a great place to stop for lunch? We tell you about some of the best waterfront restaurants accessible by boat in Naples and Marco Island. All of our vessels are inspected by the U.S.

services.name: Charter Fishing
services.desc: Port O Call Marina has eight year around independent fishing fleets offering a variety of different trips to fit everyone’s needs. Their professional staff will treat you to a day of fun whether you are with your families, friends or if you just want to jump on a trip yourself. Please check out their sites and contact them directly for booking. Come fish with us aboard the All In, one of three of the A&B Charters fleet. USCG certified for up to 19 passengers and 2 crew. We specialize in offshore fishing, consisting of half and full day fishing trips. We have been operating charter excursions since 1978 and are locally owned and operated.
